rules: All shared initial seeds must complete without a violation on every challenge and control before comparison.
Keep all declared methods and all outcomes, including ties and all-zero results.
Do not tune methods, input generation, retention, budgets, or hypotheses after viewing comparison results.
Three variants per family are related mechanism tests, not independent real-world samples.
Do not interpret synthetic family averages as a general ranking.
The existing 68-method baseline and its results remain separate.
